n44d1476fa0.why: Mercadona is Spain's largest supermarket chain by sales, and grocery price trends feed into Spanish inflation and household purchasing power.

ne2cf2ffce5.headline: Pinto (Elettricità Futura): «Electricity bills, enough demagoguery, families are protected»
ne2cf2ffce5.summary: Salvatore Pinto, president of Elettricità Futura, says families are protected on electricity bills. The statement comes despite ECB warnings and gas price increases that have been felt.
ne2cf2ffce5.why: Elettricità Futura is an Italian association representing electricity producers and sellers. Electricity and gas prices feed into inflation and household and industrial energy costs.

ne2cf2ffce5.original_headline: Pinto (Elettricità Futura): «Bollette luce, basta demagogie le famiglie sono protette»

nf458be7861.headline: SYRIZA: Fire Over 9.3 Billion Deficit Despite Tourism Rise
nf458be7861.summary: An opposition SYRIZA MP, Melidis, demanded explanations from the government over a 9.3 billion external deficit. Travel receipts rose 12% despite the deficit.
nf458be7861.why: External deficits measure the gap between a country's foreign payments and receipts, affecting its currency and financing needs.

nb75f2b4396.headline: You may be interested / Fiscal Register for corporate income tax payers has been published in the Official Gazette
nb75f2b4396.summary: New rules on the fiscal records register for obligated corporate income tax payers have been published in the Official Gazette.
nb75f2b4396.why: Fiscal registers are the record-keeping systems tax authorities use to monitor company transactions, so changes affect compliance costs for businesses.

n2b96d7adf4.headline: Poland Wants to Restrict Home Purchases by Ukrainians and Other Foreigners
n2b96d7adf4.summary: A Polish lawmaker linked high housing prices to inflows of foreign capital and proposed restricting home purchases by Ukrainians and other foreigners. No legislation was reported as passed.
n2b96d7adf4.why: Housing policy affects property prices, construction demand and foreign investment in Poland's real estate market.
